mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_cleanup_task ( task_type, source_path, destination_path, next_attempt_at ) VALUES ( 'DELETE', #{sourcePath}, NULL, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_type, source_path, destination_path, attempts, next_attempt_at, last_error, created_at FROM file_cleanup_task WHERE next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY next_attempt_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
